summary: Steel Alberta lookout, built 2015 per the provincial register at 30 m; register codes access as fly and marks it active. No site history found.

staffing.status: lookout observer per site, generally April to October (Alberta-wide statement)

access.note: Register codes access as fly and marks the tower active. No source read describes public visits.

facts.agency: Alberta Agriculture and Forestry, wildfire staff

events.note: Register construction year (YEAR_CONSTRUCTED) for the present structure.

evidence.supports: steel lookout, built 2015, 30 m tall, ground 705 m above sea level
lookouts located where visibility is favourable to detect and report wildfires
evidence.quote: Fire lookouts are an integral component of wildfire detection in Alberta and are located where visibility is favourable to detect and report wildfires.

evidence.supports: 127 lookout sites across the boreal forest and Rocky Mountains
evidence.quote: 127 wildfire lookout sites are located throughout Alberta's boreal forest and along the Rocky Mountains.

evidence.supports: each site staffed by a lookout observer, generally April to October
evidence.quote: Each site is staffed by a lookout observer whose job is to watch for wildfire all day, each day, generally from April to October.

evidence.supports: sites isolated; staff who work them must be prepared
evidence.quote: Wildfire lookout sites are isolated and the staff that work them must be prepared for a wide range of possibilities

evidence.supports: wildfire staff sit with Agriculture and Forestry
evidence.quote: Wildfire staff with Agriculture and Forestry have adopted a number of Alberta BearSmart recommendations for many of their sites

evidence.supports: towers on high hills in the boreal forest elevated the observer over obstacles to vision
evidence.quote: towers, built on high hills in the boreal forest, which elevated the observer over any obstacles to vision

evidence.supports: seasonal employees maintained trails and telephone lines and made weather observations
evidence.quote: Seasonal employees were hired to man lookouts during fire season and their job included maintaining the trails and telephone lines, as well as making weather observations.

corrections.why: The register marks the tower ACTIVE Y and codes access as fly. No source read says it is closed.

sources.title: Wildfire Lookouts of Alberta (WF_WILDFIRE_LOOKOUT), FIRES database extract

notes_for_editor: Access 'closed' in the brief is not supported. The register also marks the position as not verified, taken by GPS (LOCATION_VERIFIED N, LOCATION_VERIFIED_BY GPS). The brief's 'Alberta Wildfire' is not named in any source read; alberta.ca names Agriculture and Forestry wildfire staff. Two searches and a Wikipedia lookup (404) found no site-specific history, staffing or fire record, so the story rests on the register and general Alberta pages.
